Inputs (type the placeholder, not the example value):
- {{inputs.member_id}}: 5-digit member number (example for this run: «inputs.member_id»)

Outputs to extract:
- member_name (string): The member's full name as shown on their record
- member_number (string): The member number shown on their record

The member number failed app-side validation (e.g. not 5 digits).
Teller lacks permission to view this member's restricted account.

input.notes: Flow: on the Member Inquiry search form (right content iframe), type the member number into the Member ID field and click Search. On the resulting Member Summary screen, read the Name cell (member_name) and the Member No cell (member_number). All steps are read-only; nothing is modified. Sub-account screens (subacct_*) were not touched and are out of scope. A member_alert interstitial may appear after search and requires a human to read/confirm identity before the summary is shown.
